QuestInfo.name: [Heroes] Infiltrating Slumbering Dragon Island
QuestInfo.1: You've successfully infiltrated Slumbering Dragon Island, but you had to overcome a dark cave, a huge spider, a terrible fall, and worst of all, you got separated from Mir! Mir, where are you!?
